final_message:
I've written the Bluebird Bakery September 2026 draft for the reviewer. It's in `evals/runs/commit3-run-20261012/g_bb_no_ttm/skill_output/`:
- `bluebird-bakery-co-2026-09-trends.md` is the report, with my commentary added and the DRAFT banner kept.
- `bluebird-bakery-co-2026-09-trends.json` is the analysis every figure in the report comes from.

**Data quality: one subtotal mismatch, so the commentary opens with it.**
- **Professional Services subtotal:** in Mar 2026 the "Total for Professional Services" row says 2,225.00, but the accounts under it add up to 2,200.00, a 25.00 gap. The report uses 2,200.00; the reviewer needs to say which is right.
- **Charitable Donations:** it has no values and no total row, so it was treated as an empty account. The 4 accounts below it were kept at the level above rather than grouped under it, which the reviewer should confirm.
- **Delivery group:** the "Total Delivery" row has no heading, so the script grouped Delivery Van Fuel and Courier: Same Day under it because they add up to it every month.
- **Partial month:** no month is flagged as incomplete.
- **Last-year comparisons:** the export only covers Jan–Sep 2026, so there's no same-month-last-year or trailing-twelve-month comparison anywhere in the report.

**Key points from the commentary:**
- **Revenue was 81,300**, up 17.7% on August (69,050) and 17.3% above the previous 6-month average (69,292). Of that, 12,000 is a new stream, Wholesale Accounts, which was zero in the prior 6 months. Catering fell to 3,800, down from 9,100 in July.
- **Gross margin was 65.3%**, the highest of the period, up 5.7 points from August. Cost of sales barely moved while revenue jumped, so I've asked the reviewer whether all the costs of the new wholesale business are recorded yet.
- **Payroll rose 5,000 to 22,600**, all of it in Wages & Salaries (16,000 to 21,000), after five flat months at 17,600. Net income was 21,553, the best of the 9 months.
- **Cash fell** to 37,600, down 10,800 from six months earlier, even though every month was profitable. Equity fell from 54,660 to 44,940 over the same period. That's left as a question for the reviewer; I didn't suggest a cause.

**Accounts in "Other":** Instagram Ads, Mystery Shopper Program and Supplier Rebates (a 250 credit in September) didn't match any category rule.

In the cost table, Mystery Shopper Program shows as up "from 0" against August. It also had 400 in March and June, so the commentary describes it as quarterly rather than new.
